terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation, with the ablative
evidence: L&S: fidibus canere praeclārē, after Cic. Tusc. 1.4

terms.grammar: verb, first conjugation, with the ablative

terms.gloss: play (a drum; a stringed or keyboard instrument)
terms.comment: Strike, beat: for instruments that are struck, with the instrument as object (tympanum pulsāre), where canere takes the ablative (tubā canere).
Follows the English “play”; Latin uses canere.

phrases.english: You bang the drum; I’ll play the pipe.

phrases.latin: Possum pulsāre tympanum atque canere tubā.
phrases.english: I can play the drum and the trumpet too.

sources: Lewis & Short: cano · Lewis & Short: canto · Lewis & Short: pulso
